title: Raw resolution evaluation has the canonical cocycle class
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X\to S, nonnegative integer q, abelian etale sheaf F, its fixed chosen injective resolution injectiveResolution F, and etale S-object V, the composite rawRestrictedCohomologyComparison followed by normalizationRestrictedIso.hom and normalizationResolutionClass.app(op V) is normalizationKappa.app(op V). Equivalently, its value at every raw class z is exactly abelianHigherDirectImageClass(z). These are the prescribed maps of [def-weil-pbc-raw-restricted-normalization-data] and [def-weil-pbc-abelian-higher-image-class].

source.place: Tag 03Q8; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 072W; derived.tex Tags 0DVC and 09T5; fixed-resolution part of the parent normalization argument.

proof.text: At an arbitrary raw class z, compose with the shifted augmentation a:F[0][q] ≅ Q(I[q]). K-injectivity of I[q] and the localization bijection give a homotopy class, then a chain representative c:A[0] → I[q]. Full faithfulness of D+ into D gives Q(c)=z ≫ a; cancelling a yields z=Q(c) ≫ a.inv.

Let T be zeroth derived restricted sections and x the transported identity generator. Evaluate rawRestricted_resolution_shift_square at T(z)(x). Functoriality and z=Q(c) ≫ a.inv give T(a)(T(z)(x))=T(Q(c))(x). Apply rawRestricted_resolution_evaluation to c into the shifted K-injective resolution. Thus normalizationRestrictedIso(rawRestrictedCohomologyComparison(z)) is the shifted section cocycle of c. Apply normalizationResolutionClass to this equality.

Apply resolutionCocycle_adjunction_class to identify this image with abelianHigherDirectImageClass(z). This is normalizationKappa(z) by definition. Extensionality gives the equality of abelian-group homomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem rawRestrictedResolution_class {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (q : ℕ)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (V : S.Etale) :
    rawRestrictedCohomologyComparison f q F V ≫ normalizationIota f q F V =
      (normalizationKappa f q F).app (op V)
